description: mapping.tsx exists but the full mapping UX needs: (1) dropdowns to map brand/gtin/mpn to merchant's existing Wix custom product fields, (2) store-level defaults (e.g. condition: 'new' for all products), (3) save fieldMappings to AppConfig in Wix Data. productMapper.ts must consume these mappings at sync time rather than relying on hardcoded fallbacks. This is the Phase 5 CLAUDE.md feature.
title: Complete field mapping UI (brand/gtin/mpn custom fields)
